name: Mulch
h1: Mulch Supplies Surrey Hills & Melbourne East
title: Mulch Surrey Hills | Bulk & Bagged Delivery | SHGS
metaDescription: Pine bark, black mulch, organic and soft-play mulch in Surrey Hills. 15kg bags, bulk loads or BYO trailer. Delivered to Melbourne's east in under 2 hours.
tile: Mulches are material that is spread or laid over the surface of the soil as a covering. It is used for several purposes, to retain moisture in the soil, suppress weeds, keep the soil cool, and make the garden bed look more attractive. Our mulch is available in various sizes and colours.
imageAlt: Pine bark mulch pile at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies yard, bulk mulch delivery Melbourne east
intro: Mulch is the quickest way to make a garden bed look finished and to keep it that way. A layer spread over the soil holds moisture in through a Melbourne summer, keeps roots cool, suppresses weeds and slowly feeds the soil as it breaks down. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies keeps a full range of mulch on the yard on Canterbury Road: 10mm and 20mm pine bark, black midnight mulch, organic mulch and certified soft-play mulch for playgrounds. Every product can be bagged into 15kg bags for pickup, loaded into your own trailer, or delivered in bulk on one of our trucks. We service both trades and the general public, and in the eastern suburbs we aim to deliver in less than two hours. If you are not sure how much you need, use the volume calculator on each product page: as a rule, one cubic metre covers about 10 square metres at 100mm deep.

howToChoose.q: Garden beds you want to look sharp
howToChoose.a: 10mm pine bark gives a fine, even, chocolate-brown finish and does not blow or wash away. It is the pick for high-profile beds close to the house.

howToChoose.q: Big beds, slopes and under trees
howToChoose.a: 20mm pine bark is the same bark in a larger grade. It lasts longer, sits well on slopes and hides fallen leaves and bark.
Black midnight mulch is a dyed, recycled timber mulch that holds its colour and makes greens and flower colour stand out.
Organic mulch is composted and breaks down faster, adding organic matter. Good for vegie patches and anywhere you want to improve the soil.
Soft play mulch is a certified playground grade. It needs to be installed to the right depth, so check the product page and ask us before ordering.

faqs.q: How deep should I lay mulch?
faqs.a: Lay mulch 75–100mm deep on a new bed and 50–75mm when topping up. Keep it clear of plant stems and tree trunks to avoid rot and fungal problems in the bark.

faqs.q: How much mulch do I need?
faqs.a: One cubic metre of mulch covers roughly 10 square metres at 100mm deep, or about 13 square metres at 75mm. Use the calculator on any mulch page and add 10% for settling.

faqs.q: Can I get mulch in bags?
faqs.a: Yes. We bag every mulch into 15kg bags for yard pickup. For larger areas a bulk load delivered on our truck, or filling your own trailer, works out far cheaper per metre.

faqs.q: Do you deliver mulch to my suburb?
faqs.a: We deliver bulk mulch across Melbourne's eastern suburbs, usually in less than two hours from Surrey Hills. Call (03) 9890 3901 with your suburb and quantity and we will confirm a time.

faqs.q: Which mulch is best for weed control?
faqs.a: Any mulch laid at 75mm or more will suppress weeds. Pine bark lasts longest between top-ups; organic mulch breaks down faster but improves the soil underneath.

name: Soil
h1: Soil Supplies Surrey Hills & Melbourne East
title: Soil Surrey Hills | Garden Soil Bulk & Bagged | SHGS
metaDescription: Blended soil, premium organic soil and native garden mix from our Surrey Hills yard. 15kg bags or bulk loads delivered to Melbourne's east in under 2 hours.
tile: Our extensive range of high quality Soils and Garden Mix can be used in a variety of garden applications. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies can bag the product into 15kg bags which you can pickup from the Surrey Hills Garden Supplies yard or our trucks can deliver bulk loads to you on site.
imageAlt: Garden soil pile in a bay at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies, bulk soil delivery Melbourne east
intro: Good soil is the difference between a garden that struggles and one that takes off. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies stocks three soils that cover almost every job in a Melbourne garden: a blended soil for lawns, instant turf and general garden beds, a premium organic soil for vegetable patches and planter boxes, and a sandier native garden mix for Australian natives that need sharp drainage. All three are stored in bays on our Canterbury Road yard so you can see and handle the product before you buy. Collect it in 15kg bags, back your trailer up and we will load it, or have a bulk load delivered on one of our trucks. Trades and the public are both welcome, and deliveries in the eastern suburbs usually arrive in less than two hours. Use the calculator on each product page to work out cubic metres from the length, width and depth of your bed.

howToChoose.a: Blended soil is the ideal base under instant turf and for levelling or top dressing lawns. Lay 100mm, rake level and firm before turfing.

howToChoose.q: Vegie patches, raised beds and planter boxes
howToChoose.a: Premium organic soil is a composted, organic mix with the nutrients vegetables and flowers need. Fill the bed and plant straight into it.
Native garden mix is a sandier, low-nutrient version of blended soil. Natives such as grevilleas and banksias prefer it because it drains freely.
Call the yard and tell us what you are planting. We will point you to the right soil and the right quantity.

faqs.q: How much does a cubic metre of soil weigh?
faqs.a: Garden soil weighs roughly 1.2 tonnes per cubic metre when it is dry and more when wet. That matters for trailers: a standard 6x4 trailer carries about half a cubic metre.

faqs.q: How much soil do I need for a new lawn?
faqs.a: Allow 100mm of blended soil under instant turf. One cubic metre covers about 10 square metres at that depth. Use the calculator on the blended soil page.

faqs.q: Can I pick up soil in bags?
faqs.a: Yes. Every soil can be bagged into 15kg bags at the yard. For more than a few bags, a trailer or a bulk delivery is better value.

faqs.q: What soil should I use for vegetables?
faqs.a: Premium organic soil. It is a composted organic mix made for vegetable gardens and planter boxes. Our blog post on soil for vegetable gardens goes into more detail.

faqs.q: Do you deliver soil on weekends?
faqs.a: Delivery days and times depend on the truck schedule. Call (03) 9890 3901 and we will give you the next available slot for your suburb.

name: Sand
h1: Sand Supplies Surrey Hills & Melbourne East
title: Sand Surrey Hills | Brick, Washed & Kiln Dried | SHGS
metaDescription: Brick sand, washed sand, triple washed and kiln dried sand in Surrey Hills. Bags, bulker bags or bulk loads delivered to Melbourne's east in under 2 hours.
tile: Our premium range of sands have a variety of uses including for general garden decorating, brick laying, paving, concrete packing and filling gaps in instant turf. We stock a large variety including white sand, washed sand, triple washed sand, kiln dried sand and packing sand.
imageAlt: Washed sand bay at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies, bulk sand delivery Surrey Hills Melbourne
intro: Sand sounds simple until you use the wrong one. Brick sand holds together in mortar, washed sand drains under pavers, triple washed sand is clean enough for tiling and rendering, and kiln dried sand is bone dry so it flows into the joints of pavers and the pile of synthetic grass. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies keeps all four on the yard on Canterbury Road, plus packing sand for base work. Sand is sold loose by the cubic metre for trailers and truck deliveries, bagged for pickup, and kiln dried sand is also available in 20kg bags and one-tonne bulker bags. Bricklayers, pavers, tilers, landscapers and home renovators all buy from the same bays, and we are happy to talk you through which grade suits the job. In Melbourne's eastern suburbs we aim to have bulk sand on site in less than two hours.

howToChoose.a: White brick sand, also called builders sand. Fine, with a little clay, so mortar is workable and holds its shape on the trowel.
Washed sand. Coarse and clean, so it compacts well under pavers and is the standard sand for site-mixed concrete.
Triple washed sand. Washed three times to remove clay and silt, which keeps tile adhesives and renders clean and strong.

howToChoose.q: Synthetic grass infill and paver joints
howToChoose.a: Kiln dried sand. Oven dried so it pours freely, in 20kg bags, one-tonne bulker bags or bulk loads up to 12 cubic metres.

faqs.q: What is the difference between washed sand and brick sand?
faqs.a: Brick sand is finer and contains a small amount of clay so mortar sticks and stays workable. Washed sand is coarser with the clay washed out, so it drains and compacts, which is what you want under pavers and in concrete.

faqs.q: How much sand fits in a 6x4 trailer?
faqs.a: About half a cubic metre, which weighs around 750kg. Check your trailer's rated capacity before loading.

faqs.q: Do you sell sand in bulker bags?
faqs.a: Kiln dried sand is available in one-tonne bulker bags. Ask about bulker bags for other sands when you call.

faqs.q: Which sand do I use to top dress artificial grass?
faqs.a: Kiln dried silica sand. It is dry and free flowing so it works down between the blades and weighs the grass down. Our blog post on kiln dried sand applications explains the method.

faqs.q: Can you deliver sand on the same day?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Within the eastern suburbs we aim for delivery in under two hours. Call (03) 9890 3901 with your suburb and quantity.

name: Rock & Stone
h1: Rock & Stone Supplies Surrey Hills & Melbourne East
title: Crushed Rock & Stone Surrey Hills | Bulk Delivery | SHGS
metaDescription: Crushed rock, scoria, screenings, Tuscan toppings, 7mm aggregate and crusher dust. 15kg bags, trailer or bulk delivery from Surrey Hills to Melbourne's east.
tile: We offer a large range of rock and stone to suit all garden types. Our range includes various colours and sizes that can be used for decoration or garden foundation and irrigation. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies can bag the product into 15kg bags, and can supply bulk loads, truck loads or BYO your trailer to the site.
imageAlt: Scoria and crushed rock bays at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies, bulk stone delivery Melbourne east
intro: Rock and stone do the structural work in a landscape: the base under a driveway or shed, the drainage layer behind a retaining wall, the bedding for pipes and the decorative finish on paths and garden beds. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies stocks the grades Melbourne landscapers, plumbers and builders ask for most: 20mm crushed rock, 14mm screenings, 7mm (quarter minus) aggregate, crusher dust, scoria, Tuscan toppings and larger rubble rock from 40mm to 100mm. Everything is held in bays on our Canterbury Road yard and can be bagged into 15kg bags, loaded into your trailer, or delivered by the cubic metre on our trucks. Rock is heavy, so for anything more than a few bags a delivery is usually the easiest option. We aim to deliver in the eastern suburbs in less than two hours. The calculator on each product page converts length, width and depth into cubic metres and tonnes.

howToChoose.q: Driveways, shed bases and compacted fill
howToChoose.a: 20mm crushed rock with fines. It locks together when compacted and is the standard base material.
14mm screenings. Clean, single-size stone used in concrete and around agricultural pipe.
7mm aggregate (quarter minus) or crusher dust. Both compact to a smooth, firm bed for pavers.

howToChoose.q: Drainage behind walls and in trenches
howToChoose.a: Scoria. Light, porous volcanic rock that plumbers and landscapers use for free-draining backfill.
Tuscan toppings for a warm, compacted gravel path, or large rubble rock for dry creek beds and feature areas.

faqs.q: How much does crushed rock weigh?
faqs.a: About 1.6 tonnes per cubic metre. Scoria is much lighter at roughly 0.9 tonnes per cubic metre, which is one reason it is used behind retaining walls.

faqs.q: What is the difference between crushed rock and screenings?
faqs.a: Crushed rock includes fines (dust) so it compacts into a solid base. Screenings are washed, single-size stone with no fines, so water passes straight through.

faqs.q: Can I bring my own trailer for rock?
faqs.a: Yes. Back up to the bay and we will load it. Remember rock is heavy: a 6x4 trailer takes about half a cubic metre, which is around 800kg of crushed rock.

faqs.q: Do you sell rock in bags?
faqs.a: Yes. Every rock product can be bagged into 15kg bags at the yard for small jobs and top-ups.

faqs.q: How deep should a crushed rock base be?
faqs.a: For a garden path 75mm compacted is typical; for a driveway allow 100–150mm compacted in layers. Use the calculator and add 10% for compaction.

imageAlt: Bagged cement and concrete mix stacked at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies yard
intro: Surrey Hills Garden Supplies carries the Cement Australia bagged range so concreters, bricklayers and home builders in Melbourne's east can get everything for a pour in one stop: general purpose cement, builders cement, off-white cement, concrete mix, rapid set, mortar mix and hydrated lime, all in 20kg bags. Trade accounts and the public are both welcome. If you are unsure which cement or mesh a job needs, call and talk to the yard before you order.

howToChoose.a: General purpose cement mixed with washed sand and screenings, or bagged concrete mix for small jobs such as mower strips and post footings.
Rapid set. Pour it dry into the hole, add water and it hardens in minutes.
Builders cement or mortar mix with white brick sand, plus hydrated lime for workability.
Ute mesh for small slabs, trench mesh for strip footings, and bar chairs to hold the steel at the right height.

faqs.q: How many 20kg bags of concrete mix make a cubic metre?
faqs.a: Roughly 110 bags of 20kg concrete mix make one cubic metre. For anything over a few hundred litres, bulk concrete mix delivered by the metre is far cheaper and quicker.

faqs.q: Do you deliver bagged cement?
faqs.a: Yes. Bagged cement products can be purchased at the yard or delivered at an additional cost, on their own or with a bulk load of sand or rock.

faqs.q: What is the difference between GP cement and builders cement?
faqs.a: General purpose cement is straight cement for all-round concrete work. Builders cement is blended with fly ash or slag for better workability and later-age strength in mortars, grouts and general concrete.

faqs.q: Do you stock reinforcing mesh and bar?
faqs.a: Yes. Ute mesh, trench mesh, reo bar and starter bars are listed on the steel page, with bar chairs to suit.

faqs.q: Can I colour concrete?
faqs.a: Yes. We stock oxides in a range of colours, plus other additives, on the additives page.

imageAlt: Instant turf rolls and synthetic grass samples at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies

howToChoose.a: Smart Grass in a 30–40mm residential style. Lay it on a compacted crusher dust base and top dress with kiln dried sand.
Smart Grass 12–20mm sports grass styles, which are shorter and firmer underfoot.
Instant turf on 100mm of blended soil. Minimum order is 30 square metres.

howToChoose.q: Repairing or starting a lawn from seed
howToChoose.a: Lawn seed blends plus lawn starter and repair products from the garden products page.

faqs.q: Are you really the Australian distributor of Smart Grass?
faqs.a: Yes. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies is the Australian distributor of Smart Grass and supplies it Australia wide.

faqs.q: What goes under synthetic grass?

faqs.q: What is the minimum instant turf order?

faqs.q: Do you install synthetic grass?

faqs.q: Can I get a sample of Smart Grass?

name: Drainage
h1: Drainage Supplies Surrey Hills & Melbourne East
title: Drainage Supplies Surrey Hills | Ag Pipe & Scoria | SHGS
metaDescription: Ag pipe, plastic drainage pits and fittings, scoria and screenings for garden and site drainage. Large and small orders from Surrey Hills Garden Supplies.
tile: Our large range of quality drainage supplies offers everything needed to create effective water flow in any sized garden. We have various sized aggepipe as well as many plastic draining solutions. Large and small orders accepted.
imageAlt: Scoria drainage stone in a bay at Surrey Hills Garden Supplies
intro: Water that has nowhere to go ruins lawns, undermines paving and pushes retaining walls over. Surrey Hills Garden Supplies stocks the drainage supplies to move it: agricultural (ag) pipe in a range of sizes, plastic drainage pits, grates and fittings, geotextile fabric to keep silt out, and the stone that goes around it all, with scoria and 14mm screenings held in bays on the Canterbury Road yard. Plumbers, landscapers and home owners all buy the same kit for the same jobs: a trench behind a retaining wall, a rubble drain along a boggy fence line, or a soakage pit for a downpipe. Large and small orders are accepted, from a single length of pipe to a bulk load of scoria delivered on our truck. In Melbourne's eastern suburbs we aim to deliver in less than two hours. If you are not sure what size pipe or how much stone a trench needs, tell us the length and depth and we will work it out with you.

howToChoose.a: Slotted ag pipe in a sock at the base of the wall, backfilled with scoria, with geotextile between the scoria and the soil.
A rubble drain: trench, geotextile, ag pipe and 14mm screenings or scoria, finished with soil and turf.
Solid pipe to a pit or soakage well filled with screenings.

faqs.q: What stone goes around ag pipe?
faqs.a: Scoria or 14mm screenings. Both are free draining with no fines. Scoria is lighter and the usual choice behind walls; screenings are the usual choice in trenches.

faqs.q: What sizes of ag pipe do you stock?
faqs.a: Several sizes of agricultural pipe plus plastic fittings. Call the yard with the job and we will confirm what is on the shelf.

faqs.q: How much scoria do I need for a trench?
faqs.a: Multiply trench length by width by depth in metres for cubic metres, then use the scoria calculator to convert to tonnes or bags.

faqs.q: Do you deliver small drainage orders?
faqs.a: Yes. Large and small orders are accepted, and pipe and fittings can ride along with a bulk delivery of stone.
